verdict.rationale: Capacities documents its own templates feature, which prefills an object's properties and blocks, so reusable templates for recurring note types are first-party (docs-9). Object types such as Meetings or People give templates a natural home for recurring kinds of notes (docs-26, docs-29). However, nothing in the pack shows dynamic variables like date or title, or how templates are applied or defaulted at creation time. missing for 10: template variables (date/title placeholders), documented apply-on-create or default-template workflow per object type, independent or hands-on corroboration.
